lines.text: The same sentence, another body. What does the interpreter permit?
What a branch remembers. What returns when a branch ends?
When forward goes sideways. What does a changed reading preserve?
When a line acquires walls. Connected for which body?
Who gets the first turn? The same grammar meets soil already changed.
What counts as a change? A moving gene meets a whole-number grammar; hold and place a witness.

pearls.edge: a production rule reads only its own string, so the vine cannot answer without something outside both grammars measuring the learner's branch angle and handing it over — the dialogue depends on a translator neither side wrote.

edge_src.quote: the vine sprouts new laterals whose branch angles mirror the incoming structure

lines.text: the excavation record was never impersonal. The general intellect has a face here
Gödel as furniture — the limit is not a bug to fix but the shape of the thing
every sufficiently powerful formal system contains true statements it cannot prove
lines.note: that the weaver and the logician want the same thing is a claim about both systems and provable inside neither, so the room carries it as an axis between cloth and proof — an argument only a walking body collects.

note_src.quote: The room is arranged so the weave and the proof have to look at each other.
